fun_facts: Isaiah Likely’s hometown is Everett, Massachusetts, and he attended Everett High School.
Isaiah Likely is listed at 6 feet 4 inches tall.
In a 2021 game against Arkansas State, Isaiah Likely caught eight passes for 232 yards and four touchdowns.
One of those catches was a school-record 99-yard touchdown.
Through nine games with the Giants in 2026, Isaiah Likely had 55 catches, 575 receiving yards and seven touchdowns.
